summary: Ryan Specialty Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing an option settlement agreement with the Ryan Stock Option Trust (trustees include Executive Chairman Patrick G. Ryan). The Trust will sell to the company up to ~$52.3M of Class A common stock at the May 4, 2026 closing price, from time to time through June 9, 2036, coinciding with compensatory stock option grants to employees. The repurchases are net-neutral to share count. The stock options vest over three years starting July 2029, expiring May 2036. This structure essentially locks in a future stock buyback to offset dilution. The filing does not state a board recommendation or advisors. What to watch: eventual dilution impact and whether the repurchase price remains at the fixed initial closing price.
